source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the structure of benzene (PDF 59-60).

blocks.text: Benzene, C6H6, ahem tareen organic compounds mein se aur saada tareen aromatic hydrocarbon hai. Benzene se bane bohat se compounds ki khushbu achhi hoti hai, is liye 19wi sadi ke shuru mein benzene rings wale compounds aromatic (khushbudar) kehlaye; vanilla is ki misal hai. Aik ya zyada benzene rings wale hydrocarbons arenes kehlate hain. Aaj lafz aromatic benzene ya us jaise rings wale molecules ke liye use hota hai, chahe un ki boo kaisi bhi ho; kuch ki boo buri hoti hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Har khushbudar compound aromatic nahi hota. Camphor (kaafoor), jo camphor laurel darakht se milta hai, ki tez podine jaisi khushbu hai lekin is ki banawat mein benzene ring nahi.

Molecular formula C6H6 maloom hone ke baad chemists ne kai seedhi zanjeer wali banawatein pesh keen, lekin yeh benzene ki khasiyatein nahi samjha sakin. 1865 mein German professor August Kekule ne chhe rukni halqa pesh kiya jis mein single aur double bonds baari baari hon. Is ne kai khasiyatein samjhayein, lekin is ka poora tabeei aur kimiyai rawaiya nahi.

blocks.alt: Benzene ki Kekule banawat: chhe C atoms ka halqa (ring), har C ke saath aik H, aur carbons ke darmiyan baari baari single aur double bonds; saath hi yahi ring skeletal hexagon ki shakal mein, andar teen double-bond lakeeron ke saath.
blocks.caption: Benzene ki Kekule banawat (kitab ke PDF safha 60 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: X-ray mutale dikhate hain ke benzene hamwar (planar) hai: chhe sp2-hybridised carbon atoms ka barabar hexagon. Har carbon atom teen doosre atoms se jura hai, aur C-C-C aur H-C-C zaviye 120 darje ke hain. C-H bond 109 pm lamba aur C-C bond 139 pm hai, jo sp3 carbons ke single bond (154 pm) aur sp2 carbons ke double bond (133 pm) ke darmiyan hai. C-C aur C-H bond lambaiyan bil-tarteeb (respectively) 1.397 angstrom aur 1.09 angstrom hain.

blocks.alt: Benzene ring jis ke chhe carbons mein se har aik par H hai. 1.39 angstrom wale label se mura teer ring ke aik C-C bond ki taraf hai, aur aik carbon par mura teer ring bond aur C-H bond ke darmiyan 120 darje ka zaviya (angle) dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Benzene mein bond zaviye aur bond lambaiyan (kitab ke PDF safha 60 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kekule ki banawat mein teen chhote double bonds (133 pm) aur teen lambe single bonds (154 pm) hone chahiye the. X-ray batata hai ke benzene ke chhe ke chhe C-C bonds barabar, 139 pm (1.39 angstrom), yani in dono ke darmiyan hain, aur har zaviya 120 darje hai. Is liye aaj benzene ko aksar hexagon ke andar daire (circle) se dikhate hain: daira delocalised pi electrons hai.

blocks.prompt: X-ray data ne kyun dikhaya ke Kekule ki banawat poori kahani nahi ho sakti?
blocks.explanation: Kekule ki banawat mein teen chhote double aur teen lambe single bonds hain, lekin benzene ke chhe C-C bonds ki lambai barabar, 139 pm, hai.

items: Benzene C6H6: saada tareen arene; aromatic ab benzene jaisa ring.
Kekule (1865): baari baari bonds wala halqa.
X-ray: hamwar barabar hexagon, sab C-C 139 pm, zaviye 120 darje.
